messages:
Emily (Support): Heads up — multiple customers (ACME, BrightApps) reporting usage analytics delayed by ~3–4h on Console. Ticket refs CS-4829, CS-4831. Screenshot: https://consoleredwood/usage?org=acme shows a flatline then big spike. Anyone seen ETL/backfill issues today?
Anna Chen: I can dig in. Do we have ingestion timestamps vs processed timestamps for those orgs? Any recent deploys to analytics pipeline?
Analytics-Bot: Alert: job=usage_daily_agg failed (retryable) at 2024-03-16T02:05:08Z — DB timeout. Retry queued (attempt 2).
Emily (Support): Customers are seeing the dashboard numbers lag by hours; some think billing is wrong. Please confirm ETA so I can message them.
Prem Gupta: Jumping in. Oncall investigating DB metrics — analytics-psql-prod read replicas showing high io_wait since 01:50Z. Not yet a full outage but increases write latency.
Mike Rivera: No code deploys to the ETL in the last 6h from infra side. We did change a partition prune config yesterday that could change query plans.
Josh Kim: Quick repro steps for engineering: 1) open Console -> Usage -> set range to last 24h 2) observe last ingested hour timestamp in top-right 3) compare with raw_events.max(event_ts) from analytics DB.
Anna Chen: Running the raw check now. SQL I ran:```sql
SELECT org_id, max(event_ts) as raw_max, max(processed_at) as processed_max
FROM raw_events
LEFT JOIN processed_events USING (event_id)
WHERE org_id IN ('acme','brightapps')
GROUP BY org_id;
```
Analytics-Bot: Query digest: raw_max=2024-03-16T05:12:03Z; processed_max=2024-03-16T01:09:27Z for acme. Backfill window queued.
Emily (Support): Ugh. Customers asking for ETA. Any temporary workaround we can offer?
Mike Rivera: If processed_max lags raw by hours, the worker that consumes raw_events is falling behind. We can trigger an incremental backfill job per org.
Prem Gupta: We're seeing disk pressure on the analytics replica causing slow reads. Increasing replica pool is in progress — will take ~10m. Also starting manual backfill for critical orgs.
Josh Kim: Manual backfill snippet (use with care):
```sql
-- backfill missing hours for org
INSERT INTO usage_agg (hour, org_id, tokens)
SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_ts) as hour, org_id, sum(tokens)
FROM raw_events
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2024-03-16 01:00:00' AND '2024-03-16 06:00:00'
AND org_id = 'acme'
GROUP BY 1,2
ON CONFLICT (hour, org_id) DO UPDATE SET tokens = EXCLUDED.tokens;
```
Run via: psql -h analytics-db.prod -U reddit_analytics -c "\<above query\>"
Emily (Support): Copying that to CS reply. Can we commit to an ETA? Customer escalated to priority.
Analytics-Bot: Backfill job queued: job_id=9876, scope=org(acme,brightapps), ETA ~45m.
Anna Chen: Confirming root cause: consumer worker crashed repeatedly due to a transient FD leak in our consumer lib, causing backlog to build and then retry storms. Patch PR ready.
Prem Gupta: Oncall is patching the consumer and monitoring replica health. Disk buffer freed after rotating logs.
Mike Rivera: I'll hold the partition-prune change rollback as contingency.
Emily (Support): Thanks — I'll update customers: ETA ~45m for backfill and a postmortem follow-up. Message I plan to send: "We're investigating; we've queued a backfill and expect the Console usage numbers to catch up within an hour. We're also patching the pipeline to prevent recurrence." Good to send?
Anna Chen: good to send. Add that we're prioritizing billing-impacting orgs.
Josh Kim: After backfill completes, run this check:
```sql
SELECT org_id, max(event_ts), max(updated_at)
FROM usage_agg
GROUP BY org_id
HAVING max(updated_at) < max(event_ts) - interval '5 minutes';
```
If rows returned, re-run backfill for those orgs.
Emily (Support): Sent update to customers. CS asked for ticket to be escalated to engineering — created ENG-1284 and linked CS-4829, CS-4831.
Deploy-Bot: Deploy started: analytics/consumer v3.1.2 -> prod (patch for fd leak).
Analytics-Bot: Backfill job 9876 completed for acme (duration 34m). BrightApps queued next.
Emily (Support): Customer confirms numbers are catching up now :thumbsup:. I'll keep thread open until brightapps completes.
Prem Gupta: Monitoring looks stable; replica io_wait returning to baseline. Will follow up with postmortem.
Anna Chen: Postmortem plan: root cause fd leak in consumer lib + unobserved replica disk pressure. Action items: 1) telemetry on consumer fds 2) runbook for backfill 3) alert if processed_max lags raw_max by >1h.
Emily (Support): Great — thanks all. Closing customer comms after brightapps done. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Analytics-Bot: Backfill job 9880 (brightapps) completed.
Emily (Support): BrightApps confirmed catch-up. Closing tickets and emailing customers with incident summary and next steps.
Anna Chen: Adding postmortem draft to /docs/incidents/ENG-1284 afterhand.
Prem Gupta: marking incident as resolved.
Emily (Support): Thanks everyone — great cross-team response.
